chapter: First jobs and finding his sound
title: Staying with Sonny Stitt in Saginaw; Jimmy Lucky in Flint
summary: Working Sunshine Gardens in Saginaw he lodged with the young Sonny Stitt, then went to Flint with Jimmy Lucky's six-piece band.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Sunshine Gardens, we done the Sunshine Gardens in Saginaw, but what I'm tryin' to say is that when I was there I stayed in Sonny Stitt 's home. His mother was an ex-chorus girl and he was in high school and when he got out from school he'd come by and we'd practice and I stayed at his house all the time we was at the Sunshine Gardens in Saginaw.
How did you meet Sonny Stitt?

Well I don't know. They came by the club and I didn't have no place to stay and so he say, 'Come and stay at my house.' You know he was a very forward person, you know, he wanted to learn. In fact, then he was thinkin' about Benny Carter, You know, he had his alto and he had started listening to Benny Carter. That was my first job out of town.
So did this become a regular job?
We stayed there all that summer and then I went to Flint, Michigan, with Jimmy Lucky. He had a little six-piece band and Bernie Peacock was in the band and we did Grand Rapids and we did Flint.
